notes.content: This agreement displays all lower-division courses required in the major: CSU Northridge courses on the left, approved (articulated) transfer courses to the right. General education (Cal-GETC or CSU Northridge GE) and upper-division courses are also required to complete the bachelor's degree. Completion of all coursework listed in this agreement is not mandatory prior to admission. For CSU Northridge Undergraduate Admission Requirements , refer to Upper Division Transfer . Some coursework may be satisfied by Advanced Placement exams completed in high school. Visit AP Credit for information. Additional information about the major is available in the CSUN University Catalog . Questions regarding this agreement may be directed to: articulation@csun.edu .

notes.content: Admission to CSUN and admission to the Radiologic Sciences program are separate procedures requiring two separate applications. Completion of the prerequisite criteria and acceptance to CSUN does not guarantee acceptance to the professional program because of limited clinical placements. Non-current students may meet with the CSUN B.S. Radiologic Science advisor at least one year before their planned transfer to CSUN. An appointment may be made with a dedicated BSRS advisor directly through https://hsci.setmore.com/ . The advisor will provide guidance and confirm prerequisite course and requirement progress/completion. Pre-professional courses must be completed or in-progress to be eligible for the Professional phase of the program. Refer to the Program website for additional information. Mathematics: Either Pre-Calculus II or both ( Pre-Calculus I + Trigonometry and Analytic Geometry ) or equivalent transfer courses are accepted to satisfy the Mathematical Foundations for Non-Calculus Physics requirement.
